转换为一份新的 Motion Studio 配置。先查看转换结果，再创建；未支持: Convert to a new Motion Studio profile. Review the conversion before creating it; unsupported lines remain in the report.
可迁移常用键鼠绑定、体感开关与灵敏度、校准比例、支持的摇杆模式及完整标准虚拟手柄: Imports common keyboard/mouse bindings, gyro activation and sensitivity, calibration scale, supported stick modes and complete standard virtual controller layouts. Tap/hold, double press, commands and external references are explained line by line.
按住启用，松开恢复。未覆盖的设置与动作继承基础层；多个层按列表顺序叠加，后面的覆: Hold to activate and release to restore. Unchanged settings and actions inherit from the base layer. Layers stack in list order; later layers take priority.
这里只编辑此层的覆盖项，不会立即启用该层。体感、摇杆页面的修改同样写入当前层；输: This edits the layer's overrides without activating it. Changes on the gyro and stick pages also go into this layer. The base layer determines the output device.
此层动作会覆盖相同手柄输入在基础层的所有触发方式，其余动作继续继承。删除此层动作: A layer binding overrides all base activators for the same controller input. Other actions remain inherited. Delete the override to restore inheritance.

在「设置与组件」或「游戏配置」中选择虚拟手柄，可使用右摇杆输出。: Select a virtual controller in Settings and components or Game profiles to use right-stick output.
按住暂停键可调整握姿，松开后恢复原先的体感状态。: Hold the pause button to adjust your grip; release it to restore the previous gyro state.
灵敏度为 1× 时，达到此转速相当于将右摇杆推到底。: At 1× sensitivity, this angular velocity equals full right-stick deflection.
每旋转一度产生的基础鼠标计数，再乘以体感灵敏度。: Base mouse counts per degree of rotation, multiplied by gyro sensitivity.
慢速微调沿用基础灵敏度。快速转动时逐步提高倍率，1× 关闭加速。: Slow adjustments use base sensitivity. Fast motion progressively increases the multiplier; 1× disables acceleration.
按实际采样间隔平滑角速度，0 为关闭。: Smooth angular velocity using actual sample intervals. Set to 0 to disable.
减去微小的角速度，抑制手柄静止时的微动。: Subtract small angular velocities to suppress movement while the controller is still.
将手柄放稳后开始静止校准。校准结果保存在本机，并按设备使用。: Set the controller down before stationary calibration. Results are stored locally for each device.
先在「设备与输入」开始观察。: Start monitoring in Devices and input first.
放稳手柄，2 秒后开始采样，约 5 秒完成。: Keep the controller still. Sampling begins after 2 seconds and finishes in about 5 seconds.
外圈按推杆幅度判断，不限方向，回到内圈后释放。内圈不包含中心死区。在「动作映射」: The outer ring triggers based on how far you tilt the stick in any direction and releases when you move back inward. The inner ring excludes the center deadzone. In Action mapping, bind either ring to keys, chords, or the mouse wheel.
复用 FlexInput 的回弹过滤，抑制快速松杆时短暂越过中心造成的反向输入。: Uses FlexInput's rebound filter to suppress brief opposite inputs when a released stick overshoots the center. Disabled by default; enable it to suit your controller.
1 为线性。数值越大，小幅拨动时移动越慢。: 1 is linear. Higher values make small deflections slower.
